articles.author: Benzinga
articles.headline: Antelope Enterprise Stock Surges Nearly 38% After Hours: Why Is It Moving?
sourceWarnings: Zona horaria sin confirmar: se cuenta por fecha, sin acreditar publicación anterior a la entrada. Registrar acciones para incentivos no equivale a emitirlas todas ni confirma causalidad del movimiento.
articles.summary: Benzinga reported Antelope's prior-session after-hours rise and an S-8 registration for additional incentive-plan shares. Registration is not evidence that all those shares were already issued or that the filing caused the move.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original article July 23 1:58 AM without confirmed timezone. SEC exhibit independently identifies the incentive plan, but no publication clock is inferred from that document.
